what_this_is: Pending authoring table for the W14 residue: the N5/N4 lessons that still render no example sentence, and the 154 held links (prose-bound or lesson-emptying). Nothing here is applied. Selections come from the bank and raw Tatoeba first; generated sentences only where neither has an i+0 (or i+1) sentence at the lesson's known set.
generated_by: scratchpad build.py over git HEAD 4ffc753a + a snapshot of db/corpus.sqlite (read-only)
rule: W14's rule (derive_lesson_sentences.py): level <= lesson, build_vocab_exercises.sentence_ok (i+0, no forward reference), carries a lesson unlock, register is model text. i+1 allowed only as a named exception with exactly one unknown content word (or one unknown kanji inside a known word), load <= the level budget. Raw Tatoeba and generated sentences are checked with Sudachi full (mode C) against the same cumulative_known_set, since they have no dissection yet.
findings: 8 of the 14 lessons have item unlocks; for all 8 the i+0 rule is what binds (every bank sentence carrying an unlock is either graded above N5 or uses a word or kanji outside a 28-82 kanji known set).

6 are the review lessons (n5-revisao-01..03, n4-revisao-01..03): they unlock no vocab/kanji/grammar, so W14's add branch never ran for them. Re-targeted at the grammar they review, the bank has plenty of i+0 sentences; all 18 picks are bank sentences.

する (vocab:1157170) is first unlocked in les:n4-oracoes-relativas-07, yet N5 grammar needs it from topic 10 on. It is an unknown word in 6 held links and blocks the たり example of n5-conectando-07. Unlocking it where する is taught (N5) is a one-row fix that clears those links.

4 held links carry a token linked to the wrong homophone record (ください -> 下さる in 3, くれる -> 暮れる "escurecer" in 1); in 2 of them that is the only gap, so the fix is relinking the bank token, not touching the lesson (relink-token). 143 of 154 held links are best kept with a gloss: the prose quotes them, and most fail only on one or two kanji of a word the learner already knows.
Raw Tatoeba (248,705 sentences) supplied i+0 real sentences for 4 of the 8 item lessons; the rest are generated (ai_generated, needs_review, no trailing 。).
